OPENCTI_URL.description: The base URL of the OpenCTI instance.

OPENCTI_TOKEN.description: The API token to connect to OpenCTI.

CONNECTOR_LOG_LEVEL.description: The minimum level of logs to display.

CONNECTOR_DURATION_PERIOD.description: The period of time to await between two runs of the connector.

KASPERSKY_BASE_URL.description: Kaspersky Threat Intelligence Portal API base URL.

KASPERSKY_CERTIFICATE_PATH.description: Path to the client certificate file (PEM, certificate and private key) provided by Kaspersky. When not set, no client certificate is sent.

KASPERSKY_TLP.description: TLP marking of the imported objects (White, Green, Amber, Red).

KASPERSKY_CREATE_OBSERVABLES.description: Whether to create observables from the IoCs.

KASPERSKY_CREATE_INDICATORS.description: Whether to create indicators from the IoCs.

KASPERSKY_SCOPES.description: Comma-separated list of data to import: 'publication', 'master_ioc', 'master_yara'.

KASPERSKY_PUBLICATION_START_TIMESTAMP.description: Import publications updated after this Unix timestamp. The default value 0 imports the whole history, which is not recommended.

KASPERSKY_PUBLICATION_REPORT_TYPE.description: OpenCTI report type of the publications.

KASPERSKY_PUBLICATION_REPORT_STATUS.description: OpenCTI report status of the publications (New, In progress, Analyzed, Closed).

KASPERSKY_PUBLICATION_REPORT_IGNORE_PREF.description: Comma-separated list of name prefixes of the publications to ignore, for example 'Monthly APT activity report'.

KASPERSKY_PUBLICATION_EXCLUDED_IOC_INDIC.description: Comma-separated list of OpenIOC search values to exclude from the publications, for example 'Md5sum, FileItem/Sha1sum'.

KASPERSKY_MASTER_IOC_FETCH_WEEKDAY.description: ISO weekday (1 is Monday) on which the Master IOC is fetched. When not set, the Master IOC is fetched on every run.

KASPERSKY_MASTER_IOC_EXCLUDED_IOC_INDICA.description: Comma-separated list of OpenIOC indicator types to exclude from the Master IOC, for example 'md5Hash, sha1Hash'.

KASPERSKY_MASTER_IOC_REPORT_TYPE.description: OpenCTI report type of the Master IOC reports.

KASPERSKY_MASTER_IOC_REPORT_STATUS.description: OpenCTI report status of the Master IOC reports (New, In progress, Analyzed, Closed).

KASPERSKY_MASTER_YARA_FETCH_WEEKDAY.description: ISO weekday (1 is Monday) on which the Master YARA is fetched. When not set, the Master YARA is fetched on every run.

KASPERSKY_MASTER_YARA_INCLUDE_REPORT.description: Whether to create a report for each group of Master YARA rules.

KASPERSKY_MASTER_YARA_REPORT_TYPE.description: OpenCTI report type of the Master YARA reports.

KASPERSKY_MASTER_YARA_REPORT_STATUS.description: OpenCTI report status of the Master YARA reports (New, In progress, Analyzed, Closed).
